2026_03_HOU_IND.headline: Stroud and Taylor put Houston’s front seven at the center of an AFC South test
2026_03_HOU_IND.paragraph1: C.J. Stroud and Houston need a cleaner offensive performance after a slow start, while Indianapolis can lean on Jonathan Taylor to keep the Texans from turning the game into a pure pass-rush contest. Will Anderson Jr. has emphasized Taylor as a central problem for Houston’s defense, and that matchup should shape how often the Colts can stay balanced. If Indianapolis protects its run threat, Stroud may have fewer possessions to solve a Colts defense that has also struggled early.
2026_03_HOU_IND.model_rationale: Houston’s clearest path is disrupting Taylor before Indianapolis can dictate tempo, then giving Stroud enough possessions to attack a Colts defense that has shown vulnerability.
